key.name: folder-preview-tile-items
key.summary: Number of preview items shown in folder previews
key.description: Controls how many children are sampled and rendered in the closed folder tile and the expanded folder preview.

key.name: folder-preview-show-item-labels
key.summary: Show labels in expanded folder previews
key.description: When enabled, the expanded folder preview shows each item as icon plus name. When disabled, only icons are shown.

key.name: folder-preview-tile-size
key.summary: Preferred folder tile size in pixels
key.description: Controls the preferred square size of translucent folder tiles, while staying within the current desktop grid cell.
